name: Frontiers in Nutrition
health_claim_limitations: Research metadata is evidence for the studied question only; design, limitations and conflicts require review.
trust_notes: Научный журнал. Тип статьи, дизайн, ограничения и conflicts требуют редакционной проверки.
licensing_notes: Хранить только metadata и короткий audit excerpt; не копировать полный текст или изображения.

name: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
health_claim_limitations: Research metadata is evidence for the studied question only; do not turn it into individualized medical or training advice.
trust_notes: Научный журнал. Материал должен иметь прямую связь с тренировками, восстановлением или спортивной медициной.
licensing_notes: Хранить только metadata и короткий audit excerpt; не копировать полный текст или изображения.

name: Frontiers in Physiology
health_claim_limitations: Research metadata is evidence for the studied question only; require direct training, performance, body-composition or recovery relevance.
trust_notes: Scientific journal. The strict per-item gate must reject unrelated physiology and clinical material before provider generation.
licensing_notes: Store citation metadata and a short audit excerpt only; do not copy full text or publisher images.

name: Frontiers in Endocrinology
health_claim_limitations: Clinical endocrinology is not sufficient for eligibility; require direct body-composition, weight-management, performance or sports relevance.
trust_notes: Scientific journal. Generic disease/treatment items must fail the deterministic relevance gate.
licensing_notes: Store citation metadata and a short audit excerpt only; do not copy full text or publisher images.

name: Frontiers in Pharmacology
health_claim_limitations: Generic drug/clinical pharmacology is excluded. Sports/bodybuilding pharmacology and peptide material remains manual-review-only and non-prescriptive.
trust_notes: Scientific journal. Only direct performance, physique, body-composition or target-audience supplement relevance may pass.
licensing_notes: Store citation metadata and a short audit excerpt only; do not copy full text or publisher images.

name: PubMed fitness and health research
trust_notes: Programmatic PubMed discovery via NCBI E-utilities (ESearch + batched EFetch), not the browser RSS endpoint. Primary source, study design and limitations still require editorial verification.
licensing_notes: Keep citation metadata and a short paraphrase only; do not copy abstracts or full text beyond permitted use.
health_claim_limitations: Index metadata or abstract alone does not establish effectiveness, safety or clinical applicability; verify the primary source, study design, limitations and applicability before any health claim.

name: Cochrane systematic reviews
trust_notes: Systematic-review publisher; review scope, certainty and applicability require editorial reading.
licensing_notes: Store citation metadata and short paraphrase; respect publisher access and copyright terms.
health_claim_limitations: Certainty of evidence and review limitations must be stated where material.

name: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements
trust_notes: Official US government reference for dietary-supplement fact sheets and notices; jurisdiction is not universal.
licensing_notes: Use public metadata and concise attribution; retain links to the official page.
health_claim_limitations: US regulatory and health information must not be presented as universal classification or advice in another market.

name: US FDA food and supplement safety
trust_notes: Official US regulatory source for notices and enforcement context.
licensing_notes: Link and paraphrase public notices; do not copy page text or media wholesale.
health_claim_limitations: Regulatory status is market-specific and is not proof of product efficacy.

name: World Health Organization health news
trust_notes: International public-health source; statements remain context- and jurisdiction-sensitive.
licensing_notes: Use link, attribution and concise paraphrase under applicable terms.
health_claim_limitations: Public-health guidance is not individualized medical advice.

name: European Food Safety Authority
trust_notes: Official EU food-risk assessment source; conclusions and market rules are jurisdiction-specific.
licensing_notes: Retain the official link and concise attribution; do not republish full assessments.
health_claim_limitations: EU risk assessment or authorization does not automatically apply to other jurisdictions.

name: Examine supplement research summaries
trust_notes: Secondary discovery source only; every effectiveness or safety claim must resolve to an authoritative primary source.
licensing_notes: Use metadata for discovery and link to the secondary page; do not copy summaries.
health_claim_limitations: Secondary interpretation is not sufficient as sole evidence for health or performance claims.

name: Rospotrebnadzor public-health notices
trust_notes: Official Russian public-health and consumer-protection source; verify the exact notice and date.
licensing_notes: Use official link and concise attribution; do not copy full notices or images.
health_claim_limitations: Russian regulatory information is jurisdiction-specific and does not establish efficacy.

name: American College of Sports Medicine News
trust_notes: Official ACSM news and consensus context. Keep only items with direct fitness, exercise-science, sports-medicine or nutrition relevance.
licensing_notes: Store metadata and a short paraphrase only; retain the canonical ACSM link.
health_claim_limitations: Organization news and consensus statements still require scope and applicability review; do not convert them into individualized medical advice.

name: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
trust_notes: Peer-reviewed sports-nutrition journal. Study design, sample, conflicts and limitations require editorial verification.
licensing_notes: Store citation metadata and a short audit excerpt only; link to the publisher/DOI.
health_claim_limitations: A single study does not establish universal efficacy or safety; preserve study design and limitations.

name: Men's Health Fitness
trust_notes: Large fitness publication. Treat as secondary reporting; product/deal/listicle content must fail relevance or editorial quality gates unless there is a substantive evidence-based angle.
licensing_notes: Store title, metadata and concise paraphrase only; do not reproduce article text or publisher images.
health_claim_limitations: Secondary media is not primary evidence. Verify health, supplement and training claims against cited research before publication.

name: Stronger by Science
trust_notes: Evidence-focused strength and hypertrophy analysis. Secondary interpretation must remain linked to underlying research.
licensing_notes: Store metadata and concise paraphrase only; do not reproduce article text, charts or images.
health_claim_limitations: Verify cited studies and avoid turning population-level findings into individualized prescriptions.

name: Precision Nutrition
trust_notes: Evidence-informed nutrition and coaching publication. Use as secondary context, not as primary clinical evidence.
licensing_notes: Store metadata and concise paraphrase only; retain the canonical source link.
health_claim_limitations: Nutrition and GLP-1 material must be verified against primary/official evidence before health claims.

name: ScienceDaily Fitness
trust_notes: Research-news aggregator. Use for discovery only and verify claims in the linked primary study or institution release.
licensing_notes: Store metadata and concise paraphrase only; do not reproduce publisher text or images.
health_claim_limitations: Headlines may simplify preliminary findings; primary source verification is required.

name: MedicalXpress
trust_notes: High-volume medical and research news. Strict deterministic relevance filtering is required before provider generation.
licensing_notes: Store metadata and concise paraphrase only; retain links to MedicalXpress and the underlying research where available.
health_claim_limitations: Secondary research reporting is not sufficient evidence for efficacy, safety or clinical guidance.

name: Muscle & Fitness
trust_notes: Large strength/bodybuilding publication. Product, celebrity and promotional content must be rejected unless it carries substantive fitness evidence or industry relevance.
licensing_notes: Store metadata and concise paraphrase only; do not reproduce article text or images.
health_claim_limitations: Training, supplement and pharmacology claims require independent evidence verification.

name: Fitness Volt
trust_notes: Active bodybuilding and strength publication. Competition results and athlete news are useful for the bodybuilding domain; product/promotional claims still require editorial scrutiny.
licensing_notes: Store metadata and concise paraphrase only; do not reproduce article text or publisher images.
health_claim_limitations: Training, supplement and pharmacology claims are secondary reporting and require independent evidence verification.

name: Europe PMC fitness research
trust_notes: Programmatic literature discovery through the Europe PMC REST API. Europe PMC is an index/metadata service; verify the primary publication before editorial claims.
licensing_notes: Store bibliographic metadata and a short audit excerpt only; abstract/full-text rights remain with their respective sources.
health_claim_limitations: Indexed metadata or abstracts do not establish efficacy, safety or clinical applicability; verify study design, limitations and primary publication.
